name: Shang Tsung's Island
description: Mystical uncharted island in the Lost Sea between Earthrealm and Outworld, hosting the 10th tournament.

name: The Pit
description: Narrow stone bridge suspended over razor-sharp steel spikes, birthplace of the environmental Stage Fatality.

name: Wu Shi Academy & Shaolin Temple
description: Sacred training sanctuary of the White Lotus Society where Liu Kang and Kung Lao mastered martial arts.

name: Jinsei Chamber
description: The subterranean heart of Earthrealm containing the luminous life force protected by Raiden.

name: Pyramid of Argus
description: Colossal monolith in Edenia created by Lord Argus where all warriors converged during Armageddon.

name: The Keep of Time / The Hourglass
description: Cosmic nexus beyond realms where Titan Kronika and later Fire God Liu Kang steer time streams.

name: Shao Kahn's Throne Room
description: Imperial palace in Outworld where Emperor Shao Kahn observes gladiatorial combat and issues imperial decrees.

name: The Dead Pool
description: Outworld execution chamber filled with bubbling green acid suspended above iron grates.

name: Lin Kuei Temple (Arctika)
description: Fortress tucked within the frozen snow peaks of Arctika, ancestral home of the Lin Kuei cryomancers.

name: Shirai Ryu Fire Gardens
description: Peaceful Japanese estate established by Grandmaster Hanzo Hasashi where Shirai Ryu and Lin Kuei made peace.

name: Sea of Blood
description: Bottomless ocean of crimson ichor in the Netherrealm steered by ferryman Kharon.

name: Shinnok's Spire
description: Tower of bone and black iron where fallen Elder God Shinnok and Quan Chi rule the demonic hordes.

name: Capital of Seido
description: Geometric crystal citadel of Orderrealm governed under the rigid martial law of the Seidan Guard.

name: Palace of Chaos
description: Shifting architectural labyrinth in Chaosrealm with molten rivers where Cleric Havik holds court.
